Using the corrected section formula:

\[
G=\frac{3C+2F}{5}=\frac{3(40,40)+2(0,20)}{5}=(24,32)
\]

Triangle \(BCG\) has base \(BC=40\) and height equal to the horizontal distance from \(G=(24,32)\) to line \(BC\) (where \(x=40\)):

\[
\text{height}=40-24=16
\]

So the area is:

\[
\frac12 \cdot 40 \cdot 16 = 320
\]

\[
\boxed{320}
\]
